title: Voltrus HMI symbol (voltrus-symbol/1)
description: One ISA-101 symbol as data: symbols/<key>.json. Drawn by the web Designer and runtime (client/src/scada2/hmi/dataSymbols.tsx) and the native console from the same SVG path strings. State styling is shared, in symbols/_styles.json.

path.description: SVG path data: commands and numbers only.

condition.description: Drawn only when every named option has the value (or one of the values). Missing config keys take the option's default.

key.description: Equals the file name. Saved in a widget's config.symbol.

category.description: Palette category: Rotating equipment, Valves, Vessels, Heat transfer, Separation, Instruments, Piping.

keywords.description: Extra words the palette search matches.

viewBox.description: Drawing coordinates: width, height. Strokes do not scale.

size.description: Default widget size in stage pixels when placed.

binding.description: How the primary tag drives the symbol: on/off state, level fill (min..max of the tag), value badge, or nothing.

stretch.description: Stretch to the widget box (pipes) instead of keeping the aspect ratio.

palette.description: false: kept so saved screens draw, not offered in the palette.

ports.description: Nozzles where connections attach, per side, in viewBox units. Missing sides use the edge midpoint.

anchors.description: Named nozzles (for polyline pipes that snap to a specific nozzle).

layers.description: Drawn in order. The paint decides fill and stroke per live state (symbols/_styles.json).

width.description: Base stroke width instead of the paint's.

level.description: Level fill area of a level-bound symbol; fills from the bottom. Shell layers are filled first, the level drawn, then the outlines.

items.description: Centred text, kept upright when the symbol is rotated or mirrored.

from.description: An option key, or $level (level in %, hidden when unknown or showPercent is false).

onBody.description: Sits on a body layer: contrasting colour while the body is filled.

options.description: Per-widget settings, stored in the widget's config under their key (actuator, mounting, arrow, ...).

runTag.description: Label of the secondary run tag (config.runSensorId) that animates flow and run layers.
